parameters.name: RTL_ALT
parameters.description: Defines a cone above home which determines maximum climb

parameters.name: RTL_ALTITUDE
parameters.description: The percentage change in flap position when FLAP_1_SPEED is reached. Use zero to disable flaps

parameters.name: RTL_ALT_FINAL
parameters.description: The vehicle will climb this many cm during the initial climb portion of the RTL

parameters.name: RTL_ALT_MIN
parameters.description: When forward throttle is being controlled by the Q_FWD_THR_GAIN parameter in Q modes, the vehicle forward (nose down) pitch rotation will be limited to the value specified by this parameter and the any additional forward acceleration required will be produced by use of the forward thrust motor(s) or tilting of moveable rotors. Larger values allow the vehicle to pitch more nose down. Set initially to the amount of nose down pitch required to remove wing lift.

parameters.name: RTL_ALT_TYPE
parameters.description: GPS Hdop value at or below this value represent a good position.  Used for pre-arm checks

parameters.name: RTL_AUTOLAND
parameters.description: Automatically detect a crash during AUTO flight and perform the bitmask selected action(s). Disarm will turn off motor for safety and to help against burning out ESC and motor. Set to 0 to disable crash detection.

parameters.name: RTL_CLIMB_MIN
parameters.description: Time (in milliseconds) to loiter above home before beginning final descent

parameters.name: RTL_CONE_SLOPE
parameters.description: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain horizontally while flying home. If this is set to zero, WPNAV_SPEED will be used instead.

parameters.name: RTL_LOIT_TIME
parameters.description: Controls whether failsafe will be invoked (and what action to take) when connection with Ground station is lost for at least 5 seconds. See FS_OPTIONS param for additional actions, or for cases allowing Mission continuation, when GCS failsafe is enabled.

parameters.name: RTL_MODE
parameters.description: This enables use of VTOL in guided mode. When enabled the aircraft will switch to VTOL flight when the guided destination is reached and hover at the destination.

parameters.name: RTL_OPTIONS
parameters.description: Rangefinder filter to smooth distance.  Set to zero to disable filtering

parameters.name: RTL_RADIUS
parameters.description: Target cruise airspeed in m/s in automatic throttle modes. Value is as an indicated (calibrated/apparent) airspeed.

parameters.name: RTL_SPEED
parameters.description: This is the altitude the vehicle will move to as the final stage of Returning to Launch or after completing a mission.  Set to zero to land.

parameters.name: RUDDER_ONLY
parameters.description: Sets the amount of deflection that the rudder output will apply to the differential spoilers, as a percentage. The default value of 100 results in full rudder applying full deflection. A value of 0 will result in the differential spoilers exactly following the elevons (no rudder effect).

parameters.name: RUDD_DT_GAIN
parameters.description: When the aircraft is within this altitude of the home waypoint, while disarmed it will automatically update the home position. Set to 0 to continously reset it.

parameters.name: RUNUP
parameters.description: When exiting an autorotation in a bailout manoeuvre, this is the expected time in seconds for the main rotor to reach full speed after motor interlock is enabled. Must be at least one second longer than the H_RSC_AROT_RAMP time that is set. This timer should be set for at least the amount of time it takes to get your helicopter to full flight power. Failure to heed this warning could result in early entry into autonomously controlled collective modes (e.g. alt hold, loiter, etc), whereby the collective could be raised before the engine has reached full power, with a subsequently dangerous slowing of head speed.

parameters.name: RUNUP_TIME
parameters.description: Throttle output (HeliRSC Servo) in percent while armed but motor interlock is disabled (throttle hold on). FOR COMBUSTION ENGINES. Sets the engine ground idle throttle percentage with clutch disengaged. This must be set to zero for electric helicopters under most situations. If the ESC has an autorotation window this can be set to keep the autorotation window open in the ESC. Consult the operating manual for your ESC to set it properly for this purpose

parameters.name: RUN_CHECKSUM

parameters.name: RVMASK
parameters.description: Mask of channels which are reversed. This is used to configure ESCs to reverse motor direction for unidirectional rotation. Do not use for channels selected with SERVO_BLH_3DMASK.

parameters.name: S1_BD
parameters.description: CAN remote node number for serial port

parameters.name: S1_NOD

parameters.description: Serial protocol of DroneCAN serial port

parameters.description: Serial baud rate on remote CAN node

parameters.description: Serial port number on remote CAN node

parameters.description: Serial protocol of DroneCAN serial port

parameters.description: Serial baud rate on remote CAN node

parameters.description: Serial protocol of DroneCAN serial port

parameters.name: SAFETYOPTION
parameters.description: Minimum voltage on the autopilot power rail to allow the aircraft to arm. 0 to disable the check.

parameters.name: SAFETY_DEFLT
parameters.description: This sets the SBUS output frame rate in Hz

parameters.name: SAFETY_MASK
parameters.description: Board heater target temperature for boards with controllable heating units. Set to -1 to disable the heater, please reboot after setting to -1.

parameters.name: SAFE_DISARM
parameters.description: Time in seconds to spool up the motors from zero to min throttle.

parameters.name: SAFE_DISARM_PWM
parameters.description: 1: Scan for unknown target

parameters.name: SAFE_TIME
parameters.description: Time taken to spool down the motors from min to zero throttle. If set to 0 then SPOOL_TIME is used instead.

parameters.name: SAMPLE_MODE
parameters.description: Percentage of window to be overlapped before another frame is process. Takes effect on reboot. A good default is 50% overlap. Higher overlap results in more processed frames but not necessarily more temporal resolution. Lower overlap results in lost information at the frame edges.

parameters.name: SATS_EN
parameters.description: Displays flight mode

parameters.name: SATS_X
parameters.description: Horizontal position on screen

parameters.name: SATS_Y
parameters.description: Vertical position on screen

parameters.name: SAVE_X
parameters.description: Vertical position of Save button on screen

parameters.name: SAVE_Y
parameters.description: Vertical position of Save button on screen

parameters.name: SBUS_OUT
parameters.description: A bitmask which controls what outputs can move while the safety switch has not been pressed

parameters.name: SCALE
parameters.description: Scaling factor for 3rd compass to compensate for sensor scaling errors. If this is 0 then no scaling is done

parameters.name: SCALE2
parameters.description: Scaling factor for 3rd compass to compensate for sensor scaling errors. If this is 0 then no scaling is done

parameters.name: SCALE3
parameters.description: This sets options to change the behaviour of the compass

parameters.name: SCALING
parameters.description: Minimum RPM to report. Only used on type = GPIO.

parameters.name: SCALING_SPEED
parameters.description: Offset in degrees used for in-flight pitch trimming for level flight. Correct ground leveling is an alternative to changing this parameter.

parameters.name: SCAN_SPEED_PIT
parameters.description: 0:zero pwm, 1:trim pwm

parameters.name: SCAN_SPEED_YAW
parameters.description: This controls how rapidly the tracker will move the servos in SCAN mode

parameters.name: SDELAY
parameters.description: Duration after which slcan starts after setting SERNUM in seconds.

parameters.name: SDEV1_PROTO
parameters.description: Serial protocol of scripting serial device

parameters.name: SDEV2_PROTO
parameters.description: Serial protocol of scripting serial device

parameters.name: SDEV3_PROTO
parameters.description: Serial protocol of scripting serial device

parameters.name: SDEV_EN
parameters.description: Serial protocol of scripting serial device

parameters.name: SD_FENCE
parameters.description: This loads the DShot firmware on the IO co-processor

parameters.name: SD_MISSION
parameters.description: This sets the amount of storage in kilobytes reserved on the microsd card in fence.stg for fence storage.

parameters.name: SD_SLOWDOWN
parameters.description: This sets the voltage max for PWM output pulses. 0 for 3.3V and 1 for 5V output. On boards with an IOMCU that support this parameter this option only affects the 8 main outputs, not the 6 auxiliary outputs. Using 5V output can help to reduce the impact of ESC noise interference corrupting signals to the ESCs.

parameters.name: SELECTOR
parameters.description: This controls whether tuning values will revert on a flight mode change.

parameters.name: SEQ
parameters.description: Defines the end frequency for sweeps and dwells

parameters.name: SER1_RTSCTS
parameters.description: Enable flow control on serial 2 (telemetry 2). You must have the RTS and CTS pins connected to your radio. The standard DF13 6 pin connector for a 3DR radio does have those pins connected. If this is set to 2 then flow control will be auto-detected by checking for the output buffer filling on startup.

parameters.name: SER2_RTSCTS
parameters.description: Enable flow control on serial 4. You must have the RTS and CTS pins connected to your radio. The standard DF13 6 pin connector for a 3DR radio does have those pins connected. If this is set to 2 then flow control will be auto-detected by checking for the output buffer filling on startup.

parameters.name: SER3_RTSCTS
parameters.description: Enable flow control on serial 5. You must have the RTS and CTS pins connected to your radio. The standard DF13 6 pin connector for a 3DR radio does have those pins connected. If this is set to 2 then flow control will be auto-detected by checking for the output buffer filling on startup.

parameters.name: SER4_RTSCTS
parameters.description: Enable flow control on serial 6. You must have the RTS and CTS pins connected to your radio. The standard DF13 6 pin connector for a 3DR radio does have those pins connected. If this is set to 2 then flow control will be auto-detected by checking for the output buffer filling on startup.

parameters.name: SER5_RTSCTS
parameters.description: Enable flow control on serial 7. You must have the RTS and CTS pins connected to your radio. The standard DF13 6 pin connector for a 3DR radio does have those pins connected. If this is set to 2 then flow control will be auto-detected by checking for the output buffer filling on startup.

parameters.name: SER6_RTSCTS
parameters.description: Enable flow control on serial 8. You must have the RTS and CTS pins connected to your radio. The standard DF13 6 pin connector for a 3DR radio does have those pins connected. If this is set to 2 then flow control will be auto-detected by checking for the output buffer filling on startup.

parameters.name: SER7_RTSCTS
parameters.description: This controls the default state of the safety switch at startup. When set to 1 the safety switch will start in the safe state (flashing) at boot. When set to zero the safety switch will start in the unsafe state (solid) at startup. Note that if a safety switch is fitted the user can still control the safety state after startup using the switch. The safety state can also be controlled in software using a MAVLink message.

parameters.name: SER8_RTSCTS
parameters.description: This sets the SBUS output frame rate in Hz

parameters.name: SERIAL_NUM
parameters.description: Voltage type used for detection of low voltage event

parameters.name: SERNUM
parameters.description: Duration after which slcan starts after setting SERNUM in seconds.

parameters.name: SERVO_FN
parameters.description: Torqeedo Servo Output Function

parameters.name: SERVO_OFF
parameters.description: Parachute min altitude above home.  Parachute will not be released below this altitude.  0 to disable alt check.

parameters.name: SERVO_ON
parameters.description: Parachute Servo PWM value in microseconds when parachute is not released

parameters.name: SERVO_PITCH_TYPE
parameters.description: Rate of change of yaw in degrees/second for on/off servos

parameters.name: SERVO_YAW_TYPE
parameters.description: Rate of change of pitch in degrees/second for on/off servos

parameters.name: SER_EN
parameters.description: Serial port number on remote CAN node

parameters.name: SETPOINT
parameters.description: Time in seconds for throttle output (HeliRSC servo) to ramp from ground idle (RSC_IDLE) to flight idle throttle setting when motor interlock is enabled (throttle hold off).

parameters.name: SFUNCTION
parameters.description: Set to 0 to disable or choose a function

parameters.name: SHIP
parameters.description: This makes the position of the landing beacon follow the simulated ship from SIM_SHIP. The ship movement is controlled with the SIM_SHIP parameters

parameters.name: SHOVE_TIME
parameters.description: Rotational acceleration of twist y axis

parameters.name: SHOVE_X
parameters.description: Force to the vehicle over a period of time

parameters.name: SHOVE_Y
parameters.description: Optical Flow sensor measurement noise

parameters.name: SHOVE_Z
parameters.description: Rotational acceleration of twist x axis

parameters.name: SHUNT
parameters.description: This sets the shunt resistor used in the device

parameters.name: SIDEBARS_EN
parameters.description: Vertical position on screen

parameters.name: SIDEBARS_X
parameters.description: Displays artificial horizon crosshair (MSP OSD only)

parameters.name: SIDEBARS_Y
parameters.description: Horizontal position on screen (MSP OSD only)

parameters.name: SIDE_DIST
parameters.description: Total number of lines for ZigZag auto if 1 or more. -1: Infinity, 0: Just moving to sideways

parameters.name: SIGN
parameters.description: Simulated airspeed sensor ratio

parameters.name: SIMPLE
parameters.description: Controls whether ArduCopter will enter ESC calibration on the next restart.  Do not adjust this parameter manually.

parameters.name: SIMPLE_MODE
parameters.description: Output 0 thrust signal when blimp is within this distance (in meters) of the target position. Warning: If this param is greater than MAX_POS_XY param then the blimp won't move at all in the XY plane in Loiter mode as it does not allow more than a second's lag. Same for the other axes.

parameters.name: SIMPLE_TYPE
parameters.description: Vehicle will drift when within this distance of the target position

parameters.name: SINK_MAX
parameters.description: Use this parameter instead of LAND_ARSPD if your platform does not have an airspeed sensor.  It is the cruise throttle during landing approach.  If this value is negative then it is disabled and TECS_LAND_ARSPD is used instead.

parameters.name: SINK_MIN
parameters.description: Damping gain for throttle demand loop. Increase to add throttle activity to dampen oscillations in speed and height.

parameters.name: SIZE
parameters.description: OADatabase queue maximum number of points. This in an input buffer size. Larger means it can handle larger bursts of incoming data points to filter into the database. No impact on cpu, only RAM. Recommend larger for faster datalinks or for sensors that generate a lot of data.

parameters.name: SKIP_CAL
parameters.description: Bus number of the I2C bus where the airspeed sensor is connected. May not correspond to board's I2C bus number labels. Retry another bus and reboot if airspeed sensor fails to initialize.

parameters.name: SLEWRATE
parameters.description: Sets the throttle output (HeliRSC servo) in percent for the throttle curve at 25% of full collective travel where he 0 percent collective is defined by H_COL_MIN and 100 percent collective is defined by H_COL_MAX.  Example: if the setup has -2 degree to +10 degree collective pitch setup, the total range is 12 degrees. 25% of 12 degrees is 3 degrees, so this setting would correspond to +1 degree of pitch.

parameters.name: SLEW_DN_TIME
parameters.description: Time taken to disable and enable the motor PWM output when disarmed and armed.

parameters.name: SLEW_SPD
parameters.description: The maximum aispeed where the deepstall steering controller is allowed to have control

parameters.name: SLEW_TIME
parameters.description: Torqeedo direction change delay.  Output will remain at zero for this many seconds when transitioning between forward and backwards rotation

parameters.name: SLEW_UP_TIME
parameters.description: Time in seconds to slew output from full to zero. This is used to limit the rate at which output can change.  Range is constrained between 0 and 0.5.

parameters.name: SLEW_YAW
parameters.description: Maximum acceleration in yaw axis

parameters.name: SLOPE_A
parameters.description: The horizontal distance from which the aircraft will approach before the stall

parameters.name: SLOPE_B
parameters.description: The downward velocity of the aircraft while stalled

parameters.name: SLOPE_RCALC
parameters.description: This parameter is used when using a rangefinder during landing for altitude correction from baro drift (RNGFND_LANDING=1) and the altitude correction indicates your actual altitude is higher than the intended slope path. Normally it would pitch down steeply but that can result in a crash with high airspeed so this allows remembering the baro offset and self-abort the landing and come around for another landing with the correct baro offset applied for a perfect slope. An auto-abort go-around will only happen once, next attempt will not auto-abort again. This operation happens entirely automatically in AUTO mode. This value is the delta degrees threshold to trigger the go-around compared to the original slope. Example: if set to 5 deg and the mission planned slope is 15 deg then if the new slope is 21 then it will go-around. Set to 0 to disable. Requires LAND_SLOPE_RCALC > 0.

parameters.name: SMAX
parameters.description: FF D Gain which produces an output that is proportional to the rate of change of the target

parameters.name: SNR_MIN
parameters.description: RangeFinder Minimum signal strength (SNR) to accept distance

parameters.name: SNR_REF
parameters.description: FFT learned bandwidth at hover for the attenuation frequencies.

parameters.name: SONAR_GLITCH
parameters.description: If set, if a numerical error occurs SITL will die with a floating point exception.

parameters.name: SONAR_RND
parameters.description: The set of actuators controlled externally by CAN SITL AP_Periph

parameters.name: SONAR_ROT
parameters.description: Probablility a sonar glitch would happen

parameters.name: SONAR_SCALE
parameters.description: Opflow Data Rate

parameters.name: SPACING
parameters.description: Margin in centi-meters to accept terrain data from the GCS. This can be used to allow older terrain data generated with less accurate latitude/longitude scaling to be used

parameters.name: SPDWEIGHT
parameters.description: Maximum demanded descent rate. Do not set higher than the vertical speed the aircraft can maintain at THR_MIN, TECS_PITCH_MIN, and AIRSPEED_MAX.

parameters.name: SPD_MAX
parameters.description: The maximum climb or descent speed that the vehicle will still attempt to weathervane. Set to 0 to ignore this condition to get the aircraft to weathervane at any climb/descent rate.  This is particularly useful for aircraft with low disc loading that struggle with yaw control in decent.

parameters.name: SPD_OMEGA
parameters.description: Mixing of pitch and throttle correction for height and airspeed errors. Pitch controls altitude and throttle controls airspeed if set to 0. Pitch controls airspeed and throttle controls altitude if set to 2 (good for gliders). Blended if set to 1.

parameters.name: SPD_SCA_BASE
parameters.description: The angle between steering's middle position and maximum position when using vectored thrust (boats only)

parameters.name: SPEED
parameters.description: servo filter

parameters.name: SPEEDUP
parameters.description: XYZ position of the optical flow sensor focal point relative to the body frame origin

parameters.name: SPEED_DN
parameters.description: Defines the horizontal acceleration in cm/s/s used during missions

parameters.name: SPEED_FILT
parameters.description: True speed and direction low pass filter frequency, a value of -1 disables filter

parameters.name: SPEED_MAX
parameters.description: Bitmask to enable failsafe options

parameters.name: SPEED_MIN
parameters.description: Minimum pump speed expressed as a percentage

parameters.name: SPEED_OFS
parameters.description: True speed and direction low pass filter frequency, a value of -1 disables filter

parameters.name: SPEED_PIN
parameters.description: Wind sensor analog voltage offset at zero wind speed

parameters.name: SPEED_TYPE
parameters.description: Wind speed sensor analog temp input pin for Modern Devices Wind Sensor rev. p, set to -1 to diasble temp readings

parameters.name: SPEED_UP
parameters.description: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain while descending during a WP mission

parameters.name: SPIN
parameters.description: The pin number that the Sprayer spinner servo is connected to. (start at 1)

parameters.name: SPINNER
parameters.description: Minimum pump speed expressed as a percentage

parameters.name: SPIN_ARM
parameters.description: Motor thrust needed to hover expressed as a number from 0 to 1

parameters.name: SPIN_MAX
parameters.description: Battery voltage compensation minimum voltage (voltage below this will have no additional scaling effect on thrust).  Recommend 3.3 * cell count, 0 = Disabled

parameters.name: SPIN_MIN
parameters.description: Time constant used to limit the maximum current

parameters.name: SPOOL_TIME
parameters.description: Booster motor output scaling factor vs main throttle.  The output to the BoostThrottle servo will be the main throttle times this scaling factor. A higher scaling factor will put more of the load on the booster motor. A value of 1 will set the BoostThrottle equal to the main throttle.

parameters.name: SPOOL_TIM_DN
parameters.description: ESC 3D mode: 0=unidirectional, 1=3D PWM, 2=3D DShot

parameters.name: SPRAYER
parameters.description: The distance to move sideways in ZigZag mode

parameters.name: SQUAWK
parameters.description: ADSB vehicle list altitude filter. Vehicles detected more than this altitude above our own altitude will be completely ignored. They will not show up in the SRx_ADSB stream to the GCS and will not be considered in any avoidance calculations. A value of 0 will disable this filter.

parameters.name: SRC
parameters.description: Sensor Source Identification is used to replace a specific instance of a system component's temperature report with the temp sensor's. Examples: TEMP_SRC = 1 (ESC), TEMP_SRC_ID = 1 will set the temp of ESC1. TEMP_SRC = 3 (BatteryIndex),TEMP_SRC_ID = 2 will set the temp of BATT2. TEMP_SRC = 4 (BatteryId/SerialNum),TEMP_SRC_ID=42 will set the temp of all batteries that have param BATTn_SERIAL = 42.

parameters.name: SRC_ID
parameters.description: Sensor Source Identification is used to replace a specific instance of a system component's temperature report with the temp sensor's. Examples: TEMP_SRC = 1 (ESC), TEMP_SRC_ID = 1 will set the temp of ESC1. TEMP_SRC = 3 (BatteryIndex),TEMP_SRC_ID = 2 will set the temp of BATT2. TEMP_SRC = 4 (BatteryId/SerialNum),TEMP_SRC_ID=42 will set the temp of all batteries that have param BATTn_SERIAL = 42.

parameters.name: SRV_BM
parameters.description: Node ID to send ECU throttle messages to. Set to zero to disable ECU throttle messages. Set to 255 to broadcast to all ECUs.

parameters.name: SRV_RT
parameters.description: Output rate of ECU command messages

parameters.name: STAB_PITCH_DOWN
parameters.description: This controls the minimum altitude change for a waypoint before a glide slope will be used instead of an immediate altitude change. The default value is 15 meters, which helps to smooth out waypoint missions where small altitude changes happen near waypoints. If you don't want glide slopes to be used in missions then you can set this to zero, which will disable glide slope calculations. Otherwise you can set it to a minimum number of meters of altitude error to the destination waypoint before a glide slope will be used to change altitude.

parameters.name: STALL_PREVENTION
parameters.description: Minimum airspeed demanded in automatic throttle modes. Should be set to 20% higher than level flight stall speed.

parameters.name: STARTCHN_MIN
parameters.description: Maximum RPM for the engine provided by the manufacturer. A value of 0 disables this feature. See ICE_OPTIONS to enable or disable the governor.

parameters.name: STARTER_TIME
parameters.description: This is the measured RPM above which the engine is considered to be running

parameters.name: STARTUP
parameters.description: Polarity for feedback pin. If this is 1 then the pin should be high when gear are deployed. If set to 0 then then deployed gear level is low.

parameters.name: STARTUP_DELAY
parameters.description: This allows selection of position servos or on/off servos for yaw

parameters.name: START_CHAN
parameters.description: Delay between start attempts

parameters.name: START_DELAY
parameters.description: This is the value sent to the ignition channel when on

parameters.name: START_LATITUDE
parameters.description: Combined with START_LATITUDE this parameter allows for an initial position of the tracker to be set. This position will be used until the GPS gets lock. It can also be used to run a stationary tracker with no GPS attached.

parameters.name: START_LONGITUDE
parameters.description: This parameter can be used to force the servos to their trim value for a time on startup. This can help with some servo types

parameters.name: START_PCT
parameters.description: This configures the RPM that will be commanded by the idle governor. Set to -1 to disable

parameters.name: STATE
parameters.description: Explicitly specify an error code to send to the generator

parameters.name: STATS_EN
parameters.description: Displays total flight time

parameters.name: STATS_X
parameters.description: Horizontal position on screen

parameters.name: STATS_Y
parameters.description: Vertical position on screen

parameters.name: STB_COL_1
parameters.description: Helicopter's collective pitch setting at mid-low (40%) collective stick input in Stabilize mode. Set this as a percent of collective range given by H_COL_MAX minus H_COL_MIN.

parameters.name: STB_COL_2
parameters.description: Helicopter's collective pitch setting at mid-high (60%) collective stick input in Stabilize mode. Set this as a percent of collective range given by H_COL_MAX minus H_COL_MIN.

parameters.name: STB_COL_3
parameters.description: Helicopter's maximum collective pitch setting at full collective stick input in Stabilize mode. Set this as a percent of collective range given by H_COL_MAX minus H_COL_MIN.

parameters.name: STB_COL_4
parameters.description: Helicopter's maximum collective pitch setting at full collective stick input in Stabilize mode. Set this as a percent of collective range given by H_COL_MAX minus H_COL_MIN.

parameters.name: STICK_MIXING
parameters.description: Minimum forward acceleration in m/s/s before arming the ground speed check in auto-takeoff. This is meant to be used for hand launches. Setting this value to 0 disables the acceleration test which means the ground speed check will always be armed which could allow GPS velocity jumps to start the engine. For hand launches and bungee launches this should be set to around 15. Also see TKOFF_ACCEL_CNT paramter for control of full "shake to arm".

parameters.name: STOP_PIN
parameters.description: This parameter sets the estimated terrain distance in meters above which the sensor will be put into a power saving mode (if available). A value of zero means power saving is not enabled

parameters.name: STRICT
parameters.description: Time for which vehicle continues descend even if target is lost. After this time period, vehicle will attempt a landing retry depending on PLND_STRICT parameter.

parameters.name: STRT_MX_RTRY
parameters.description: If set 0 then there is no limit to retrials. If set to a value greater than 0 then the engine will retry starting the engine this many times before giving up.

parameters.name: STR_THR_MIX
parameters.description: Thrust Asymetry. Used for skid-steering. 2.0 means your motors move twice as fast forward than they do backwards.

parameters.name: SUM_MASK
parameters.description: 0: sum of remaining battery monitors, If none 0 sum of specified monitors. Current will be summed and voltages averaged.

parameters.name: SUPER_SIMPLE
parameters.description: The descent speed for the final stage of landing in cm/s

parameters.name: SURFACE_DEPTH
parameters.description: Allows setting an individual MAVLink system id for this vehicle to distinguish it from others on the same network

parameters.name: SURFTRAK_DEPTH
parameters.description: Minimum depth to engage SURFTRAK mode

parameters.name: SURFTRAK_MODE
parameters.description: DeadReckoning is available for this many seconds after losing position and/or velocity source.  After this timeout elapses the EKF failsafe will trigger in modes requiring a position estimate

parameters.name: SURFTRAK_TC
parameters.description: Takeoff is not permitted until motors report no more than this RPM.  Set to zero to disable check

parameters.name: SV_MAN
parameters.description: Maximum cyclic pitch angle of the swash plate.  There are no units to this parameter.  This should be adjusted to get the desired cyclic blade pitch for the pitch and roll axes.  Typically this should be 6-7 deg (measured blade pitch angle difference between stick centered and stick max deflection.

parameters.name: SV_TEST
parameters.description: Number of cycles to run servo test on boot-up

parameters.name: SW2_COL_DIR
parameters.description: Automatically set when H3 generic swash type is selected for swashplate 2. Do not set manually.

parameters.name: SW2_H3_ENABLE
parameters.description: Azimuth position on swashplate 2 for servo 2 with the front of the heli being 0 deg

parameters.name: SW2_H3_PHANG
parameters.description: For intermeshing mode only. Yaw revereser smoothing exponent, smoothen transition near zero collective region. Increase this parameter to shink smoothing range. Set to -1 to disable reverser.

parameters.name: SW2_H3_SV1_POS
parameters.description: Azimuth position on swashplate 2 for servo 3 with the front of the heli being 0 deg

parameters.name: SW2_H3_SV2_POS
parameters.description: Only for H3 swashplate.  If pitching the swash forward induces a roll, this can be correct the problem

parameters.name: SW2_H3_SV3_POS
parameters.description: Removes I term bias due to center of gravity offsets or discrepancies between rotors in swashplate setup. If DCP axis has I term bias while hovering in calm winds, use value of bias in DCP_TRIM to re-center I term.

parameters.name: SW2_LIN_SVO
parameters.description: Azimuth position on swashplate for servo 1 with the front of the heli being 0 deg

parameters.name: SW2_TYPE
parameters.description: This linearizes the swashplate 2 servo's mechanical output to account for nonlinear output due to arm rotation.  This requires a specific setup procedure to work properly.  The servo arm must be centered on the mechanical throw at the servo trim position and the servo trim position kept as close to 1500 as possible. Leveling the swashplate can only be done through the pitch links.  See the ardupilot wiki for more details on setup.

parameters.name: SW_COL_DIR
parameters.description: Automatically set when H3 generic swash type is selected for swashplate 1. Do not set manually.

parameters.name: SW_H3_ENABLE
parameters.description: Azimuth position on swashplate 1 for servo 2 with the front of the heli being 0 deg

parameters.name: SW_H3_PHANG
parameters.description: Direction collective moves for positive pitch. 0 for Normal, 1 for Reversed

parameters.name: SW_H3_SV1_POS
parameters.description: Azimuth position on swashplate 1 for servo 3 with the front of the heli being 0 deg

parameters.name: SW_H3_SV2_POS
parameters.description: Only for H3 swashplate.  If pitching the swash forward induces a roll, this can be correct the problem

parameters.name: SW_H3_SV3_POS
parameters.description: H3 is generic, three-servo only. H3_120/H3_140 plates have Motor1 left side, Motor2 right side, Motor3 elevator in rear. HR3_120/HR3_140 have Motor1 right side, Motor2 left side, Motor3 elevator in front - use H3_120/H3_140 and reverse servo and collective directions as necessary. For all H3_90 swashplates use H4_90 and don't use servo output for the missing servo. For H4-90 Motors1&2 are left/right respectively, Motors3&4 are rear/front respectively. For H4-45 Motors1&2 are LF/RF, Motors3&4 are LR/RR

parameters.name: SW_LIN_SVO
parameters.description: Azimuth position on swashplate for servo 1 with the front of the heli being 0 deg

parameters.name: SW_TYPE
parameters.description: This linearizes the swashplate 1 servo's mechanical output to account for nonlinear output due to arm rotation.  This requires a specific setup procedure to work properly.  The servo arm must be centered on the mechanical throw at the servo trim position and the servo trim position kept as close to 1500 as possible. Leveling the swashplate can only be done through the pitch links.  See the ardupilot wiki for more details on setup.

parameters.name: SYNAIRSPEED
parameters.description: This parameter sets the airspeed at which no feed-forward is applied between demanded airspeed and pitch. It should correspond to the airspeed in metres per second at which the plane glides at neutral pitch including STAB_PITCH_DOWN.

parameters.name: SYSID
parameters.description: Slung Payload MAVLink system id to distinguish it from others on the same network

parameters.name: SYSID_ENFORCE
parameters.description: This controls whether packets from other than the expected GCS system ID will be accepted

parameters.name: SYSID_MYGCS
parameters.description: Altitude that altitude control modes will climb to when a takeoff is triggered with the throttle stick.

parameters.name: SYSID_TARGET
parameters.description: This controls how rapidly the tracker will change the servo output for pitch. It is set as the number of seconds to do a full range of pitch movement. You can use this parameter to slow the trackers movements, which may help with some types of trackers. A value of zero will allow for unlimited servo movement per update.

parameters.name: SYSID_THISMAV
parameters.description: Throttle filter cutoff (Hz) - active whenever altitude control is inactive - 0 to disable

parameters.name: TAIL_SPEED
parameters.description: PWM in microseconds sent to external gyro on an servo/output whose function is Motor7 when tail type is Servo w/ ExtGyro in mode ACRO instead of H_GYR_GAIN. A value of zero means to use H_GYR_GAIN

parameters.name: TAIL_TYPE
parameters.description: PWM in microseconds sent to external gyro on an servo/output whose function is Motor7 when tail type is Servo w/ ExtGyro

parameters.name: TAKEOFF
parameters.description: Options impacting weathervaning behaviour

parameters.name: TARG_SP
parameters.description: Cut-off frequency for collective low pass filter.  For the entry phase.  Acts as a following trim.  Must be higher than AROT_COL_FILT_G.

parameters.name: TAU_OUTPUT
parameters.description: This state process noise controls the growth of body magnetic field state error estimates. Increasing it makes magnetometer bias error estimation faster and noisier.

parameters.name: TCONST
parameters.description: This is the gain from the integral of steering angle. Increasing this gain causes the controller to trim out steady offsets due to an out of trim vehicle.

parameters.name: TELEM_DELAY
parameters.description: bitmask of PIDs to send MAVLink PID_TUNING messages for

parameters.name: TEMP_BFACTOR
parameters.description: Altitude at which wind reaches full strength, decaying from full strength as altitude lowers to ground level

parameters.name: TEMP_BRD_OFF
parameters.description: A pressure change with temperature that closely matches what has been observed with a ICM-20789

parameters.name: TEMP_EN
parameters.description: Displays Horizontal Dilution Of Position

parameters.name: TEMP_PIN
parameters.description: apparent Wind speed low pass filter frequency, a value of -1 disables filter

parameters.name: TEMP_START
parameters.description: Barometer warmup temperature time constant

parameters.name: TEMP_TCONST
parameters.description: Allows you to set vertical wind direction (true deg) in sim. 0 means pure horizontal wind. 90 means pure updraft.

parameters.name: TEMP_X
parameters.description: Horizontal position on screen

parameters.name: TEMP_Y
parameters.description: Vertical position on screen

parameters.name: TERMINATE
parameters.description: This sets a digital output pin to set high on flight termination. Some common values are given, but see the Wiki's "GPIOs" page for how to determine the pin number for a given autopilot.

parameters.name: TERM_ACTION
parameters.description: This sets the AMSL (above mean sea level) altitude limit. If the pressure altitude determined by QNH exceeds this limit then flight termination will be forced. Note that this limit is in meters, whereas pressure altitude limits are often quoted in feet. A value of zero disables the pressure altitude limit.

parameters.name: TERM_PIN
parameters.description: This sets margin for error in GPS derived altitude limit. This error margin is only used if the barometer has failed. If the barometer fails then the GPS will be used to enforce the AMSL_LIMIT, but this margin will be subtracted from the AMSL_LIMIT first, to ensure that even with the given amount of GPS altitude error the pressure altitude is not breached. OBC users should set this to comply with their D2 safety case. A value of -1 will mean that barometer failure will lead to immediate termination.

parameters.name: TERRAIN
parameters.description: Total number of ADSB simulated aircraft

parameters.name: TERRAIN_FOLLOW
parameters.description: This sets the rate in m/s at which FBWB and CRUISE modes will change its target altitude for full elevator deflection. Note that the actual climb rate of the aircraft can be lower than this, depending on your airspeed and throttle control settings. If you have this parameter set to the default value of 2.0, then holding the elevator at maximum deflection for 10 seconds would change the target altitude by 20 meters.

parameters.name: TERRAIN_LOOKAHD
parameters.description: This sets the rate in m/s at which FBWB and CRUISE modes will change its target altitude for full elevator deflection. Note that the actual climb rate of the aircraft can be lower than this, depending on your airspeed and throttle control settings. If you have this parameter set to the default value of 2.0, then holding the elevator at maximum deflection for 10 seconds would change the target altitude by 20 meters.

parameters.name: TERR_GRAD
parameters.description: This sets the percentage number of standard deviations applied to the range beacon measurement innovation consistency check. Decreasing it makes it more likely that good measurements will be rejected. Increasing it makes it more likely that bad measurements will be accepted.

parameters.name: TER_HGT_EN
parameters.description: Displays average cell voltage. WARNING: this can be inaccurate if the cell count is not detected or set properly. If the  the battery is far from fully charged the detected cell count might not be accurate if auto cell count detection is used (OSD_CELL_COUNT=0).

parameters.name: TER_HGT_X
parameters.description: Horizontal position on screen

parameters.name: TER_HGT_Y
parameters.description: Vertical position on screen

parameters.name: TER_MARGIN
parameters.description: Defines the maximum cornering acceleration in cm/s/s used during missions.  If zero uses 2x accel value.

parameters.name: TEST
parameters.description: This sets the rate in Hz for requesting telemetry from ESCs. It is the rate per ESC. Setting to zero disables telemetry requests

parameters.name: TESTS
parameters.description: Networking options

parameters.name: THD_PRIORITY
parameters.description: Serial protocol of scripting serial device

parameters.name: THEN_NEUTRL
parameters.description: The amount of flaps (as a percentage) to apply in the landing approach and flare of an automatic landing

parameters.name: THML_ARSPD
parameters.description: This sets the flap when in LOITER with soaring active. Overrides the usual auto flap behaviour.

parameters.name: THML_BANK
parameters.description: If non-zero this airspeed will be used when cruising between thermals in AUTO. If set to -1, airspeed will be selected based on speed-to-fly theory. If set to 0, then AIRSPEED_CRUISE will be used while cruising between thermals.

parameters.name: THML_FLAP
parameters.description: This sets the flap when in LOITER with soaring active. Overrides the usual auto flap behaviour.

parameters.name: THML_SCENARI
parameters.description: SITL vicon position on vehicle in Right direction

parameters.name: THRCRV_0
parameters.description: Sets the throttle output (HeliRSC servo) in percent for the throttle curve at 25% of full collective travel where he 0 percent collective is defined by H_COL_MIN and 100 percent collective is defined by H_COL_MAX.  Example: if the setup has -2 degree to +10 degree collective pitch setup, the total range is 12 degrees. 25% of 12 degrees is 3 degrees, so this setting would correspond to +1 degree of pitch.

parameters.name: THRCRV_100
parameters.description: RPM range +/- governor rpm reference setting where governor is operational. If speed sensor fails or rpm falls outside of this range, the governor will disengage and return to throttle curve. Recommended range is 100

parameters.name: THRCRV_25
parameters.description: Sets the throttle output (HeliRSC servo) in percent for the throttle curve at 50% of full collective travel where he 0 percent collective is defined by H_COL_MIN and 100 percent collective is defined by H_COL_MAX.  Example: if the setup has -2 degree to +10 degree collective pitch setup, the total range is 12 degrees. 50% of 12 degrees is 6 degrees, so this setting would correspond to +4 degree of pitch.

parameters.name: THRCRV_50
parameters.description: Sets the throttle output (HeliRSC servo) in percent for the throttle curve at 75% of full collective travel where he 0 percent collective is defined by H_COL_MIN and 100 percent collective is defined by H_COL_MAX.  Example: if the setup has -2 degree to +10 degree collective pitch setup, the total range is 12 degrees. 75% of 12 degrees is 9 degrees, so this setting would correspond to +7 degree of pitch.

parameters.name: THRCRV_75
parameters.description: Sets the throttle output (HeliRSC servo) in percent for the throttle curve at the minimum collective pitch position. The 100 percent collective is defined by H_COL_MAX.  Example: if the setup has -2 degree to +10 degree collective pitch setup, this setting would correspond to +10 degree of pitch.

parameters.name: THROTTLE
parameters.description: Yaw channel number. This is useful when you have a RC transmitter that can't change the channel order easily. Yaw (also known as rudder) is normally on channel 4, but you can move it to any channel with this parameter.  Reboot is required for changes to take effect.

parameters.name: THROTTLE_EN
parameters.description: Enables display of compass rose

parameters.name: THROTTLE_EXPO
parameters.description: The maximum pitch rate at full stick deflection in QACRO mode

parameters.name: THROTTLE_NUDGE
parameters.description: The time in seconds that a failsafe condition has to persist before a short failsafe event will occur. This defaults to 1.5 seconds

parameters.name: THROTTLE_X
parameters.description: Horizontal position on screen

parameters.name: THROTTLE_Y
parameters.description: Vertical position on screen

parameters.name: THROW_ALT_MAX
parameters.description: Maximum altitude under which Throw mode will detect a throw or a drop - 0 to disable the check

parameters.name: THROW_ALT_MIN
parameters.description: Maximum altitude under which Throw mode will detect a throw or a drop - 0 to disable the check

parameters.name: THROW_MOT_START
parameters.description: Maximum altitude under which Throw mode will detect a throw or a drop - 0 to disable the check

parameters.name: THROW_NEXTMODE
parameters.description: Ground Effect Compensation Enable/Disable

parameters.name: THROW_TYPE
parameters.description: Ground Effect Compensation Enable/Disable

parameters.name: THR_DAMP
parameters.description: Maximum vertical acceleration used to correct speed or height errors.

parameters.name: THR_DZ
parameters.description: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1230, <= 1360

parameters.name: THR_FAILSAFE
parameters.description: Target percentage of throttle to apply for flight in automatic throttle modes and throttle percentage that maintains AIRSPEED_CRUISE. Caution: low battery voltages at the end of flights may require higher throttle to maintain airspeed.

parameters.name: THR_FS_VALUE
parameters.description: When enabled, this uses the throttle input in auto-throttle modes to 'nudge' the throttle or airspeed to higher or lower values. When you have an airspeed sensor the nudge affects the target airspeed, so that throttle inputs above 50% will increase the target airspeed from AIRSPEED_CRUISE up to a maximum of AIRSPEED_MAX. When no airspeed sensor is enabled the throttle nudge will push up the target throttle for throttle inputs above 50%.

parameters.name: THR_G_BOOST
parameters.description: Throttle-gain boost ratio. A value of 0 means no boosting is applied, a value of 1 means full boosting is applied. Describes the ratio increase that is applied to angle P and PD on pitch and roll.

parameters.name: THR_MAX
parameters.description: Throttle slew rate as a percentage of total range per second. A value of 100 allows the motor to change over its full range in one second.  A value of zero disables the limit.  Note some NiMH powered rovers require a lower setting of 40 to reduce current demand to avoid brownouts.

parameters.name: THR_MAX_PWM
parameters.description: This is the speed below which the quad motors will provide stability and lift assistance in fixed wing modes. The default value of 0 disables assistance but will generate a pre-arm failure to encourage users to set this parameter to -1, or a positive, non-zero value. If this is set to -1 then all Q_ASSIST features are disabled except during transitions. A high non-zero,positive value will lead to more false positives which can waste battery. A lower value will result in less false positive, but will result in assistance taking longer to trigger. If unsure then set to 3 m/s below the minimum airspeed you will fly at. If you don't have an airspeed sensor then use 5 m/s below the minimum airspeed you fly at.

parameters.name: THR_MIN
parameters.description: Throttle maximum percentage the autopilot will apply. This can be used to prevent overheating an ESC or motor on an electric rover

parameters.name: THR_MIN_PWM
parameters.description: This is the maximum PWM output for the quad motors

parameters.name: THR_MIX_MAN
parameters.description: Pitch axis rate controller input frequency in Hz

parameters.name: THR_MIX_MAX
parameters.description: Roll axis rate controller input frequency in Hz

parameters.name: THR_MIX_MIN
parameters.description: Throttle vs attitude control prioritisation used during manual flight (higher values mean we prioritise attitude control over throttle)

parameters.name: THR_PASS_STAB
parameters.description: The PWM level on the throttle input channel below which throttle failsafe triggers. Note that this should be well below the normal minimum for your throttle channel.

parameters.name: THR_REF
parameters.description: FFT attenuation level in dB for bandwidth calculation and peak detection. The bandwidth is calculated by comparing peak power output with the attenuated version. The default of 15 has shown to be a good compromise in both simulations and real flight.

parameters.name: THR_SLEW
parameters.description: After a landing has completed using a LAND waypoint, automatically disarm after this many seconds have passed. Use 0 to not disarm.

parameters.name: THR_SLEWRATE
parameters.description: maximum percentage change in flap output per second. A setting of 25 means to not change the flap by more than 25% of the full flap range in one second. A value of 0 means no rate limiting.

parameters.name: THR_SUPP_MAN
parameters.description: 0 disables the failsafe. 1 enables failsafe on loss of RC input. This is detected either by throttle values below THR_FS_VALUE, loss of receiver valid pulses/data, or by the FS bit in receivers that provide it, like SBUS. A programmable failsafe action will occur and RC inputs, if present, will be ignored. A value of 2 means that the RC inputs won't be used when RC failsafe is detected by any of the above methods, but it won't trigger an RC failsafe action.

parameters.name: THR_VT
parameters.description: Scale from PID output to control surface, for use where a single axis is actuated by both motors and Tilt/control surface on a copter style tailsitter, increase to favor control surfaces and reduce motor output by reducing gains

parameters.name: THST_ASYM
parameters.description: Thrust Asymetry. Used for skid-steering. 2.0 means your motors move twice as fast forward than they do backwards.

parameters.name: THST_EXPO
parameters.description: Battery voltage compensation maximum voltage (voltage above this will have no additional scaling effect on thrust).  Recommend 4.2 * cell count, 0 = Disabled

parameters.name: THST_HOVER
parameters.description: Disables motor PWM output when disarmed

parameters.name: TIDE_DIR
parameters.description: Specifies vehicle's startup longitude

parameters.name: TIDE_SPEED
parameters.description: Specifies vehicle's startup altitude (AMSL)

parameters.name: TIMEOUT
parameters.description: Vehicle will continue landing vertically even if target is lost below this height. This needs a rangefinder to work. Set to zero to disable this.

parameters.name: TIME_CONST
parameters.description: Integrator gain to trim out long-term speed and height errors.

parameters.name: TIME_JITTER
parameters.description: Simulated RPM when motors are armed

parameters.name: TIME_OUT
parameters.description: Bitmask of AIS logging options

parameters.name: TIMOUT
parameters.description: Duration after which slcan starts after setting SERNUM in seconds.

parameters.name: TKOFF_ACCEL_CNT
parameters.description: This is amount of deflection applied to the two outer surfaces for differential spoilers for flaps to give crow flaps. It is a number from 0 to 100. At zero no crow flaps are applied. A recommended starting value is 25.

parameters.name: TKOFF_ARSP_LIM
parameters.description: This is the altitude below which quadplane assistance will be triggered. This acts the same way as Q_ASSIST_ANGLE and Q_ASSIST_SPEED, but triggers if the aircraft drops below the given altitude while the VTOL motors are not running. A value of zero disables this feature. The altitude is calculated as being above ground level. The height above ground is given from a Lidar used if available and RNGFND_LANDING=1. Otherwise it comes from terrain data if TERRAIN_FOLLOW=1 and comes from height above home otherwise.

parameters.name: TKOFF_FAIL_SCL
parameters.description: This is the altitude below which quadplane assistance will be triggered. This acts the same way as Q_ASSIST_ANGLE and Q_ASSIST_SPEED, but triggers if the aircraft drops below the given altitude while the VTOL motors are not running. A value of zero disables this feature. The altitude is calculated as being above ground level. The height above ground is given from a Lidar used if available and RNGFND_LANDING=1. Otherwise it comes from terrain data if TERRAIN_FOLLOW=1 and comes from height above home otherwise.

parameters.name: TKOFF_FLAP_PCNT
parameters.description: This controls the maximum bank angle in degrees during flight modes where level flight is desired, such as in the final stages of landing, and during auto takeoff. This should be a small angle (such as 5 degrees) to prevent a wing hitting the runway during takeoff or landing. Setting this to zero will completely disable heading hold on auto takeoff while below 5 meters and during the flare portion of a final landing approach.

parameters.name: TKOFF_IGAIN
parameters.description: This enables the use of synthetic airspeed in TECS for aircraft that don't have a real airspeed sensor. This is useful for development testing where the user is aware of the considerable limitations of the synthetic airspeed system, such as very poor estimates when a wind estimate is not accurate. Do not enable this option unless you fully understand the limitations of a synthetic airspeed estimate. This option has no effect if a healthy airspeed sensor is being used for airspeed measurements.

parameters.name: TKOFF_OPTIONS
parameters.description: This parameter sets the airspeed at which to stop holding the tail down and transition to rudder control of steering on the ground. When TKOFF_TDRAG_SPD1 is reached the pitch of the aircraft will be held level until TKOFF_ROTATE_SPD is reached, at which point the takeoff pitch specified in the mission will be used to "rotate" the pitch for takeoff climb. Set TKOFF_TDRAG_SPD1 to zero to go straight to rotation. This should be set to zero for hand launch and catapult launch. It should also be set to zero for tricycle undercarriages unless you are using the method above to gently hold the nose wheel down. For tail dragger aircraft it should be set just below the stall speed.

parameters.name: TKOFF_PLIM_SEC
parameters.description: The amount of flaps (as a percentage) to apply in automatic takeoff

parameters.name: TKOFF_ROTATE_SPD
parameters.description: This parameter sets the slew rate for the throttle during auto takeoff. When this is zero the THR_SLEWRATE parameter is used during takeoff. For rolling takeoffs it can be a good idea to set a lower slewrate for takeoff to give a slower acceleration which can improve ground steering control. The value is a percentage throttle change per second, so a value of 20 means to advance the throttle over 5 seconds on takeoff. Values below 20 are not recommended as they may cause the plane to try to climb out with too little throttle. A value of -1 means no limit on slew rate in takeoff.

parameters.name: TKOFF_RPM_MAX
parameters.description: EKF Failsafe filter cutoff frequency. EKF variances are filtered using this value to avoid spurious failsafes from transient high variances. A higher value means the failsafe is more likely to trigger.

parameters.name: TKOFF_RPM_MIN
parameters.description: Takeoff is not permitted until motors report at least this RPM.  Set to zero to disable check

parameters.name: TKOFF_SLEW_TIME
parameters.description: Takeoff is not permitted until motors report at least this RPM.  Set to zero to disable check

parameters.name: TKOFF_TDRAG_ELEV
parameters.description: This parameter sets the airspeed at which to stop holding the tail down and transition to rudder control of steering on the ground. When TKOFF_TDRAG_SPD1 is reached the pitch of the aircraft will be held level until TKOFF_ROTATE_SPD is reached, at which point the takeoff pitch specified in the mission will be used to "rotate" the pitch for takeoff climb. Set TKOFF_TDRAG_SPD1 to zero to go straight to rotation. This should be set to zero for hand launch and catapult launch. It should also be set to zero for tricycle undercarriages unless you are using the method above to gently hold the nose wheel down. For tail dragger aircraft it should be set just below the stall speed.

parameters.name: TKOFF_TDRAG_SPD1
parameters.description: This parameter sets the airspeed at which the aircraft will "rotate", setting climb pitch specified in the mission. If TKOFF_ROTATE_SPD is zero then the climb pitch will be used as soon as takeoff is started. For hand launch and catapult launches a TKOFF_ROTATE_SPD of zero should be set. For all ground launches TKOFF_ROTATE_SPD should be set above the stall speed, usually by about 10 to 30 percent. During the run, use TKOFF_GND_PITCH to keep the aircraft on the runway while below this airspeed.

parameters.name: TKOFF_THR_DELAY
parameters.description: This sets the time that maximum throttle will be forced during a fixed wing takeoff.

parameters.name: TKOFF_THR_MAX
parameters.description: EKF Failsafe filter cutoff frequency. EKF variances are filtered using this value to avoid spurious failsafes from transient high variances. A higher value means the failsafe is more likely to trigger.

parameters.name: TKOFF_THR_MAX_T
parameters.description: The minimum throttle to use in takeoffs in AUTO and TAKEOFF flight modes, when TKOFF_OPTIONS bit 0 is set. Also, the minimum throttle to use in a quadpane forward transition. This can be useful to ensure faster takeoffs or transitions on aircraft where the normal throttle control leads to a slow takeoff or transition. It is used when it is larger than THR_MIN, otherwise THR_MIN is used instead.

parameters.name: TKOFF_THR_MIN
parameters.description: This parameter sets the amount of elevator to apply during the initial stage of a takeoff. It is used to hold the tail wheel of a taildragger on the ground during the initial takeoff stage to give maximum steering. This option should be combined with the TKOFF_TDRAG_SPD1 option and the GROUND_STEER_ALT option along with tuning of the ground steering controller. A value of zero means to bypass the initial "tail hold" stage of takeoff. Set to zero for hand and catapult launch. For tail-draggers you should normally set this to 100, meaning full up elevator during the initial stage of takeoff. For most tricycle undercarriage aircraft a value of zero will work well, but for some tricycle aircraft a small negative value (say around -20 to -30) will apply down elevator which will hold the nose wheel firmly on the ground during initial acceleration. Only use a negative value if you find that the nosewheel doesn't grip well during takeoff. Too much down elevator on a tricycle undercarriage may cause instability in steering as the plane pivots around the nosewheel. Add down elevator 10 percent at a time.

parameters.name: TKOFF_THR_MINACC
parameters.description: This parameter sets the time delay (in 1/10ths of a second) that the ground speed check is delayed after the forward acceleration check controlled by TKOFF_THR_MINACC has passed. For hand launches with pusher propellers it is essential that this is set to a value of no less than 2 (0.2 seconds) to ensure that the aircraft is safely clear of the throwers arm before the motor can start. For bungee launches a larger value can be used (such as 30) to give time for the bungee to release from the aircraft before the motor is started.

parameters.name: TKOFF_THR_MINSPD
parameters.description: Minimum forward acceleration in m/s/s before arming the ground speed check in auto-takeoff. This is meant to be used for hand launches. Setting this value to 0 disables the acceleration test which means the ground speed check will always be armed which could allow GPS velocity jumps to start the engine. For hand launches and bungee launches this should be set to around 15. Also see TKOFF_ACCEL_CNT paramter for control of full "shake to arm".

parameters.name: TKOFF_THR_SLEW
parameters.description: This parameter reduces the pitch minimum limit of an auto-takeoff just a few seconds before it reaches the target altitude. This reduces overshoot by allowing the flight controller to start leveling off a few seconds before reaching the target height. When set to zero, the mission pitch min is enforced all the way to and through the target altitude, otherwise the pitch min slowly reduces to zero in the final segment. This is the pitch_min, not the demand. The flight controller should still be commanding to gain altitude to finish the takeoff but with this param it is not forcing it higher than it wants to be.

parameters.name: TKOFF_TIMEOUT
parameters.description: This scales down the inner flaps so less than full downwards range can be used for differential spoiler and full span ailerons, 100 is use full range, upwards travel is unaffected

parameters.name: TMAX
parameters.description: This is the 1st order temperature coefficient from a temperature calibration

parameters.name: TMIN
parameters.description: The maximum temperature that the calibration is valid for. This must be at least 10 degrees above TMIN for calibration

parameters.name: TMOUT
parameters.description: When set to 1 this enabled verbose debugging output over MAVLink when the blheli protocol is active. This can be used to diagnose failures.

parameters.name: TOP_PWM_AIR
parameters.description: Climb mode air PWM minimum

parameters.name: TOP_PWM_REV_MAX
parameters.description: Climb mode reverse PWM maximum (independent from underwater)

parameters.name: TOP_PWM_REV_MIN
parameters.description: Climb mode reverse PWM minimum (independent from underwater)

parameters.name: TOP_PWM_UW
parameters.description: Climb mode underwater PWM minimum

parameters.name: TOP_THRUST_AIR
parameters.description: Climb Start state rear motor thrust underwater

parameters.name: TOP_THRUST_UW
parameters.description: Climb Start state front motor normalized thrust

parameters.name: TOTAL
parameters.description: Bitmask of what options to use in missions.

parameters.name: TRANSITION_MS
parameters.description: The maximum ascending vertical velocity the pilot may request in m/s

parameters.name: TRANS_DECEL
parameters.description: This sets the compensation for the pitch angle trim difference between calibrated AHRS level and vertical flight pitch. NOTE! this is relative to calibrated AHRS trim, not forward flight trim which includes PTCH_TRIM_DEG. For tailsitters, this is relative to a baseline of 90 degrees in AHRS.

parameters.name: TRANS_FAIL
parameters.description: Amount of curvature in throttle curve: 0 is linear, 1 is cubic

parameters.name: TRANS_FAIL_ACT
parameters.description: The maximum altitude change allowed during land detection. You can raise this value if you find that landing detection takes a long time to complete. It is the maximum change in altitude over a period of 4 seconds for landing to be detected

parameters.name: TRAN_PIT_MAX
parameters.description: Controls major frame class for multicopter component

parameters.name: TRATE
parameters.description: When set to a non-zero value this overrides the output type for the output channels given by SERVO_BLH_MASK. This can be used to enable DShot on outputs that are not part of the multicopter motors group.

parameters.name: TRIM
parameters.description: Function assigned to this servo. Setting this to Disabled(0) will setup this output for control by auto missions or MAVLink servo set commands. any other value will enable the corresponding function

parameters.name: TRIM_PITCH
parameters.description: This sets the compensation for the pitch angle trim difference between calibrated AHRS level and vertical flight pitch. NOTE! this is relative to calibrated AHRS trim, not forward flight trim which includes PTCH_TRIM_DEG. For tailsitters, this is relative to a baseline of 90 degrees in AHRS.

parameters.name: TRIM_THROTTLE
parameters.description: The action to take on a short (FS_SHORT_TIMEOUT) failsafe event. A short failsafe event can be triggered either by loss of RC control (see THR_FS_VALUE) or by loss of GCS control (see FS_GCS_ENABL). If in CIRCLE or RTL mode this parameter is ignored. A short failsafe event in stabilization and manual modes will cause a change to CIRCLE mode if FS_SHORT_ACTN is 0 or 1, a change to FBWA mode with zero throttle if FS_SHORT_ACTN is 2, and a change to FBWB mode if FS_SHORT_ACTN is 4. In all other modes (AUTO, GUIDED and LOITER) a short failsafe event will cause no mode change if FS_SHORT_ACTN is set to 0, will cause a change to CIRCLE mode if set to 1, will change to FBWA mode with zero throttle if set to 2, or will change to FBWB if set to 4. Please see the documentation for FS_LONG_ACTN for the behaviour after FS_LONG_TIMEOUT seconds of failsafe. This parameter only applies to failsafes during fixed wing modes. Quadplane modes will switch to QLAND unless Q_OPTIONS bit 5(QRTL) or 20(RTL) are set.

parameters.name: TRIM_X
parameters.description: Not Used

parameters.name: TRIM_Y
parameters.description: Overall board orientation relative to the standard orientation for the board type. This rotates the IMU and compass readings to allow the board to be oriented in your vehicle at any 90 or 45 degree angle. The label for each option is specified in the order of rotations for that orientation. This option takes affect on next boot. After changing you will need to re-level your vehicle. Firmware versions 4.2 and prior can use a CUSTOM (100) rotation to set the AHRS_CUSTOM_ROLL/PIT/YAW angles for AHRS orientation. Later versions provide two general custom rotations which can be used, Custom 1 and Custom 2, with CUST_ROT1_ROLL/PIT/YAW or CUST_ROT2_ROLL/PIT/YAW angles.

parameters.name: TRIM_Z
parameters.description: This controls the time constant for the cross-over frequency used to fuse AHRS (airspeed and heading) and GPS data to estimate ground velocity. Time constant is 0.1/beta. A larger time constant will use GPS data less and a small time constant will use air data less.

parameters.name: TRUE_FILT
parameters.description: True speed and direction low pass filter frequency, a value of -1 disables filter

parameters.name: TUBE_ORDR
parameters.description: This parameter allows you to set the PSI (pounds per square inch) range for your sensor. You should not change this unless you examine the datasheet for your device

parameters.name: TUNE
parameters.description: Controls motor mixing for multicopters.  Not used for Tri or Traditional Helicopters.

parameters.name: TUNE_MAX
parameters.description: Maximum value that the parameter currently being tuned with the transmitter's channel 6 knob will be set to

parameters.name: TUNE_MIN
parameters.description: Maximum value that the parameter currently being tuned with the transmitter's channel 6 knob will be set to

parameters.name: TURBO_MODE
parameters.description: Enables double speed on high offset.

parameters.name: TURN_RADIUS
parameters.description: Acro mode turn rate maximum

parameters.name: TWIST_TIME
parameters.description: Simulated orientation of the IMUs sailboat wave and tide simulation parameters

parameters.name: TWIST_X
parameters.description: Time that twist is applied on the vehicle

parameters.name: TWIST_Y
parameters.description: Ground behavior of aircraft (tailsitter, no movement, forward only)

parameters.name: TWIST_Z
parameters.description: Simulated orientation of the IMUs sailboat wave and tide simulation parameters

parameters.name: TXT_RES
parameters.description: Displays the RC link transmit (TX) power in mW or W, depending on level

parameters.name: TYPE
parameters.description: Precland device maximum lateral range

parameters.name: UART_LOSS
parameters.description: specifies which simulated ADSB types are active

parameters.name: UP

parameters.name: USE_REV_THRUST
parameters.description: Defines the maximum distance from a waypoint that when crossed indicates the waypoint may be complete. To avoid the aircraft looping around the waypoint in case it misses by more than the WP_RADIUS an additional check is made to see if the aircraft has crossed a "finish line" passing through the waypoint and perpendicular to the flight path from the previous waypoint. If that finish line is crossed then the waypoint is considered complete. Note that the navigation controller may decide to turn later than WP_RADIUS before a waypoint, based on how sharp the turn is and the speed of the aircraft. It is safe to set WP_RADIUS much larger than the usual turn radius of your aircraft and the navigation controller will work out when to turn. If you set WP_RADIUS too small then you will tend to overshoot the turns.

Decreasing it makes it more likely that good measurements will be rejected. Increasing it makes it more likely that bad measurements will be accepted. If EK3_GLITCH_RAD has been set to 0 the horizontal position innovations will be clipped instead of rejected if they exceed the gate size so a smaller value of EK3_POS_I_GATE not exceeding 300 is recommended to limit the effect of GPS transient errors.

parameters.name: WP_LOITER_RAD
parameters.description: Defines the radius of the loiter circle when in RTL mode. If this is zero then WP_LOITER_RAD is used. If the radius is negative then a counter-clockwise is used. If positive then a clockwise loiter is used.

This overrides the "cross the finish line" logic that is normally used to consider a waypoint complete. For normal AUTO behaviour this parameter should be set to zero. Using a non-zero value is only recommended when it is critical that the aircraft does approach within the given radius, and should loop around until it has done so. This can cause the aircraft to loop forever if its turn radius is greater than the maximum radius set.

parameters.description: If LOG_DISARMED is set to 1 then logging will be enabled at all times including when disarmed. Logging before arming can make for very large logfiles but can help a lot when tracking down startup issues and is necessary if logging of EKF replay data is selected via the LOG_REPLAY parameter. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 2, then logging will be enabled when disarmed, but not if a USB connection is detected. This can be used to prevent unwanted data logs being generated when the vehicle is connected via USB for log downloading or parameter changes. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 3 then logging will happen while disarmed, but if the vehicle never arms then the logs using the filesystem backend will be discarded on the next boot.

parameters.name: _RATE_FLTE
parameters.description: Sets an upper limit on the slew rate produced by the combined P and D gains. If the amplitude of the control action produced by the rate feedback exceeds this value, then the D+P gain is reduced to respect the limit. This limits the amplitude of high frequency oscillations caused by an excessive gain. The limit should be set to no more than 25% of the actuators maximum slew rate to allow for load effects. Note: The gain will not be reduced to less than 10% of the nominal value. A value of zero will disable this feature.

parameters.name: _VEL_FLTE
parameters.description: Velocity (horizontal) feed forward gain.  Converts the difference between desired velocity to a target acceleration

parameters.name: _VEL_I
parameters.description: Velocity (horizontal) integrator maximum.  Constrains the target acceleration that the I gain will output

parameters.name: _VEL_IMAX
parameters.description: Velocity (horizontal) input filter.  This filter (in Hz) is applied to the input for D term

parameters.name: _VEL_M_NSE
parameters.description: Visual odometry yaw measurement noise minimum (radians), This value will be used if the sensor provides a lower noise value (or no noise value)

parameters.name: _VEL_P
parameters.description: Velocity (horizontal) D gain.  Corrects short-term changes in velocity

parameters.name: _VFOV
parameters.description: Camera vertical field of view. 0 if unknown

parameters.name: _VMAX
parameters.description: This sets the thrust multiplier when voltage is low

parameters.name: _VMIN
parameters.description: This sets the thrust multiplier when voltage is high

parameters.name: _V_OFFSET
parameters.description: Set level at which RSSI item will flash (in positive % or negative dBm values as applicable). 30% or -100dBm are defaults.

parameters.name: _WIND_GATE
parameters.description: The maximum percentage speed change in airspeed reports that is allowed due to offset changes between calibrations before a warning is issued. This potential speed error is in percent of ASPD_FBW_MIN. 0 disables. Helps warn of calibrations without pitot being covered.

parameters.name: _WIND_MAX
parameters.description: Number of standard deviations applied to the re-enable EKF consistency check that is used when ARSPD_OPTIONS bit position 3 is set. Larger values will make the re-enabling of the airspeed sensor faster, but increase the likelihood of re-enabling a degraded sensor. The value can be tuned by using the ARSP.TR log message by setting ARSPD_WIND_GATE to a value that is higher than the value for ARSP.TR observed with a healthy airspeed sensor. Occasional transients in ARSP.TR above the value set by ARSPD_WIND_GATE can be tolerated provided they are less than 5 seconds in duration and less than 10% duty cycle.

parameters.name: _WIND_WARN
parameters.description: The maximum percentage speed change in airspeed reports that is allowed due to offset changes between calibrations before a warning is issued. This potential speed error is in percent of ASPD_FBW_MIN. 0 disables. Helps warn of calibrations without pitot being covered.

parameters.name: _W_ACRVOLT

parameters.name: _W_AVGCELLV

parameters.name: _W_BATVOLT

parameters.name: _W_LQ
parameters.description: Extends the spacing between the sidebar elements by this amount of columns. Positive values increases the width to the right of the screen.

parameters.name: _W_NSAT
parameters.description: Sets the units to use in displaying items

parameters.name: _W_RESTVOLT
parameters.description: Set level at which RC_LQ item will flash (%)

parameters.name: _W_RSSI
parameters.description: Set level at which BAT_VOLT item will flash

parameters.name: _W_SNR
parameters.description: Increase of vertical length of the sidebar itens by this amount of lines. Applied equally both above and below the default setting.

parameters.name: _W_TERR
